user.title: Polestar Energy
user.description:
Sign in with the same Polestar ID you use in the Polestar Energy app.

1. Open this link:

{authorize_url}

2. After login, your browser will try to open an app URL starting with `com.polestar.smartcharging://`.
3. Copy that full URL and paste it below.

A LukeDev.co.uk / HairyDuck integration. Unofficial; not affiliated with Polestar or Jedlix.

error.invalid_redirect: Could not find an authorisation code in that URL. Paste the full com.polestar.smartcharging:// link.
error.auth_failed: Sign-in failed or the token was rejected. Try the login link again.
error.cannot_connect: Signed in, but charge sessions could not be loaded. Check your Polestar Energy account and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Polestar Energy account is already set up
